title: Slash insights track
description: A left-aligned serif heading with an italic word and a grey line, two small round arrow buttons on the right, and a sideways track of article cards that starts on the page column and runs out to the window edge: a 16:9 thumbnail with 8px corners (a gentle zoom on hover), a warm category with a dot and small-caps date, a two-line 20px headline and a grey reading time.
notes: the track swipes and snaps without JavaScript; the arrows need it (hydrate)
category text uses the theme's glow colour
